title: 产品发布前完整指南
description:
Pre-Launch Product Guide — Complete checklist and playbook for launching products successfully. From 4 weeks before launch to Day 1. Covers: audience building, waitlist strategy, beta testing, launch timing, Product Hunt preparation, Reddit/HackerNews seeding, KOL outreach, and post-launch momentum. Real case studies from Manus, Devin, AFFiNE (30x PH #1 winner).
